summary: Example eAPI task backs up the EOS config and passes proxy_env to the task's environment.
questions: How do I pass proxy settings to an eAPI task?

answer_card.title: eAPI task with proxy
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
- name: Backup current switch config (eos)
  arista.eos.eos_config:
    backup: yes
  register: backup_eos_location
  environment: "{{ proxy_env }}"
  when: ansible_network_os == 'arista.eos.eos'
```
